title.note: Game title kept byte-identical (glossary: keep); Czech players search and see the English Roblox title.

hud.cast.note: Angler's verb for casting (nahodit prut); infinitive, the Czech button norm. 7/8.

hud.reel.note: Angler's verb for reeling in (navíjet vlasec); imperfective fits the ongoing action while the fish bites. Same root as the pass Autonavíjení. 7/8.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so 0, 1, 2-4 and 5+ all read correctly (1 návnada, 2 návnady, 5 návnad). 9/10.

catch.success.note: Guide pattern '{rarity} mazlíček: {pet}!' with úlovek (catch) as head noun: avoids gendered 'Chytil jsi' and keeps {fish} in the nominative. Masculine úlovek agrees with masculine rarity tags (Vzácný, Mýtický; Legendární is the same for every gender), so every rarity.* key must be the masculine nominative.

catch.escaped.note: Generic ryba as the context allows; past tense agrees with ryba, not the player. Trailing ellipsis kept for the disappointed tone the context asks for, as the single character the guide uses.

catch.new_record.note: No-break space before kg. For the developer: {weight} arrives as 12.4, but Czech writes 12,4; format it with a decimal comma for cs-cz.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Invented name: lucerna (lantern) keeps the glowing-lantern idea and reads like a Czech species name. Alternative: Světélkující úhoř (glowing eel), which loses the lantern echo. 14/18.

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine tier form, per the guide's rarity rule and agreeing with úlovek in catch.success; Czech gamers read Mýtický as above Legendární.

shop.rods.note: Prut is the angler's word for a fishing rod (not tyč, a metal rod).

shop.equip.note: Standard Czech game verb for equip; pairs with the status label Vybaveno.

shop.equipped.note: Impersonal neuter status form, like Zakoupeno or Odemčeno in Czech UI: agrees with neither the rod nor the player's gender. Alternative: Používáš (you're using it).

shop.buy_robux.note: Guide reference wording; Robux undeclined after the number.

pass.auto_reel.note: Built from navíjet (hud.reel) with the solid auto- prefix, as in autopilot; Automatické navíjení (20) is over the budget. 12/14. The Creator Hub pass name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Návnada štěstí zdvojnásobí šanci na vzácné ryby!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Pass name follows the guide's Lucky Potion -> Lektvar štěstí pattern (návnada + štěstí). 'your' dropped; vzácné matches the Rare tier Vzácný.

sell.done.note: Label form so count and coins of 1 still read correctly (no noun after a number); Prodáno is impersonal, so no gender. The + marks coins earned, standing in for 'for {coins} coins'.

sell.prompt.note: Guide pattern 'Otevři klávesou E'; avoids the calque 'pro prodej'. 17/21.

ascend.button.note: Vzestup = rise, ascent in the figurative sense (no religious or climbing reading). Noun on the button per the Czech button norm. Alternative: Prestiž, which Czech gamers know from shooters but loses the Ascend image.

ascend.confirm.text: Provést vzestup teď? Začneš od začátku, ale vzácné ryby budeš chytat o {bonus} % častěji.
ascend.confirm.note: Infinitive question as in the guide's rebirth.confirm; future tense (Začneš, budeš chytat) avoids gender. Space before % because it is a quantity (o 25 % častěji). No-break spaces after the preposition o and before %.

weather.storm.text: Blíží se bouřka! Vzácné ryby berou.
weather.storm.note: 'Ryby berou' is the Czech angler's idiom for fish biting.

quest.catch_n.note: Count after a colon so n = 1 also works (1 rybu / 2 ryby / 5 ryb otherwise). Moonlit Bay -> Měsíční zátoka (terms.json), here in the locative. Alternative if the label reads odd: 'Chyť rybu v Měsíční zátoce ({n}×)'.

friends.boost.text: Rybaření s kamarády ti dává +{percent} % ke štěstí
friends.boost.note: Statement, not an order. kamarády per the guide (přátelé can read as boyfriends). Space before % because it is a quantity of luck (+10 % ke štěstí), unlike the adjectival '+10% bonus' in the guide.

trade.sent.note: Head noun hráči (dative) carries the case, so {player} is never declined; odeslána agrees with žádost. 32/33, tight.

trade.accept.note: Present tense, as the guide advises, avoids gendered přijal/přijala for {player}; 'agrees to the trade' is how a Czech notification would say it. 'your' dropped. Alternative: 'Hráč {player} přijal výměnu' (head-noun pattern).

codes.redeemed.note: Redeem = uplatnit (guide); uplatněn agrees with kód.

afk.kicked.text: Už moc dlouho nic neděláš, takže se rybaření zastavilo.
afk.kicked.note: Present tense for the idling (still true when the message shows) avoids gendered 'byl jsi nečinný / přestal jsi'; zastavilo agrees with rybaření. No kick added.

event.ends.note: For the developer: {time} arrives as '2d 4h'; Czech writes '2 d 4 h' with spaces (d and h stay valid).

daily.streak.text: Série: {day}. den! Vrať se zítra pro další odměnu.
daily.streak.note: Label form with the ordinal period (3. den) works for every day, including 1. 'for more' as one more daily reward, as in the guide's reward.come_back.

tip.night.text: Tip: některé ryby berou jen v noci.
tip.night.note: 'berou' is the angler's word for biting. Lowercase after the colon, the Czech default. No-break space after v.

group.join.text: Vstup do skupiny a získej 50 návnad zdarma!
group.join.note: Guide wording for groups; 50 is a fixed number, so the genitive plural návnad is correct. No-break space after a.

leaderboard.biggest.note: Nejtěžší (heaviest) states the weight ranking the context asks for; Největší úlovek is the looser angler phrase.
